GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly and Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, Moved Up Two Wide from the 700m and took the Lead at 600m, led Two Wide by a half head turning, Headed 250m, kept trying but couldn't match it with the winner in Straight # winner too good
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn 2 Lengths Two Wide , ran on in Straight hitting Lead at the 150m, kept going to post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the winning post on the first occasion commenced to over race and when being steadied, raced with its head up and shifted out approaching the crossing.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward from Outside sat 2nd Outside 1 Lengths off leader/winner , happy to stalk Ridden Along Turning for home 3rd Outside 2 Lengths , couldn't quicken Couldn'T Go On x 200m - # not one excuse
Jumped Ok comf Went Forward Settled Down Run Of Race 3rd Inside 2 Lengths off leader/winner into 2nd x 400m, Kept Finding had its chance - # had last crack
Jumped well Wide out pushing on Settled Down close up Outside Leader (1200m), Under Pressure before Turn & 3 Wide approaching Turn , Straightened Up spent faded out of it # struggling b4 turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported after being caught wide early, elected to press on and join the leader near the 1400m-added mare was not suited to the synthetic surface.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, very Wide first bend, Settled Down 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 2.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # always Wide

Jumped okay, Restrained & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Two Wide , Held Up 400m-300m and Drifted Back to 9 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out to centre of track Straightening Up and Made Ground down the running # got too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running from passing the 400m until approaching the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out then Went Forward to 3 Wide joint Lead settling down, in Two Wide entering first turn, Headed 1400m and Drifted Back to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # no real excuses
Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 2 lengths. back to 4th 1000 metres. got split turn 2 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rounding the first turn was steadied after improving onto heels. Travelled keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay,m Wide entering first turn before moving up to Two Wide joint Lead settling down, went clear 1500m, crossed and led fence middle stages, joint Lead from the 600m, led 2 Lengths jointly turning, Headed 100m and lost a length to the line. # battled on fairly

Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, Held Up home turn then charged into cutaway, hit Lead 200m, narrowly Headed 150m, kept battling to line. (Cross-over Nose Band ON) # battled on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 500m became held up on heels and was unable to improve until shifting in shortly after straightening.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide Lead by 1 length , led rail entering first turn, Restrained when racing ungenerouly at 1500m, Lost Ground being Headed 1400m then Held Together in 2nd place middle stages, moved back up to trail Two Wide by a head turning, Dropped Out in Straight # weakened noticeably
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Commenced to race ungenerously near the 1500m and when restrained lost ground rapidly.
